Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the time this morning  great to connect. As discussed, to help speed up procurement/security review on your side, we're kicking off the vendor security questionnaire process. Attached is a blank SIG (exported to PDF for your tracker) and a copy of our standard NDA for reference.

High-level answers we covered on the call:
- SOC 2: in progress, Type II report expected Q3 2027 (in-house controls + independent audit firm).
- Data residency: US regions by default; EU region available for EU customers.
- PHI: our hosted API can be used with PHI under a signed BAA (we discussed scoping options).

Clarifying questions for your team to help us prioritize which questionnaire version to complete:
1) Do you want the full SIG/Consensus CAIQ or is the SIG Lite sufficient for initial assessment?
2) Are you scoping Redwood for production access to PHI (will a BAA be required)?
3) Any specific evidence artifacts you prefer up-front (SOC 2 audit report, penetration test report, architecture diagram, KMS key rotation policy)?

Next steps: if you confirm which template(s) you prefer, we will assign our security team (cc'd) and return a completed SIG/CAIQ within 5 business days. If a BAA is required, I can loop in legal to start that conversation in parallel.

Attachments: Midsize_SW_SIG.pdf, Midsize_SW_NDA.pdf

Thanks,
